#2

#3
Welcome to Real Easy English.
#4
Find all the vocabulary and a worksheet
#5
to test what you've learned over on our website.
#6
Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
#7
Hi Phil. How are you doing?
#8
I'm doing really well, Georgie.
#9
I must say, your hair is looking fantastic today.
#10
Thank you very much, Phil.
#11
Today we are talking about hair.
#12
Now, I can see your hair,
#13
but for our listeners maybe you can start by describing your hair.
#14
OK. Well, my hair – it's short, but it's not very short.
#15
I think it's fairly straight.
#16
And then the colour – it's kind of a light brown colour.
#17
The bits that aren't grey, that is!
#18
You said your hair used to be ginger.
#19
Yes, it used to be ginger – bright orange.
#20
Wow! Well, my hair is naturally dark brown.
#21
It's quite short and it's wavy, so sometimes it can be curly,
#22
but mostly it's wavy.
#23
OK. So, you've told us about your hair, Georgie.
#24
Do you like it?
#25
Yes, I do now.
#26
I actually... When I was younger,
#27
I didn't really like my hair because I wanted it to be straight,
#28
so I used to straighten it – take the curls and the waves out.
#29
But as I've got older, I've started to really like my hair.
#30
It looks a bit wild and I enjoy it.
#31
What about you? How do you...
#32
Do you like your hair?
#33
Yeah, usually I do.
#34
I think similar to you.
#35
When I was a teenager, I just wanted my hair to look different,
#36
so I used to try and stick hair gel in it and try
#37
and make it do things that it didn't want to do and it wasn't going to do.
#38
And I used to get very frustrated about that.
#39
And then as you get older and wiser, you realise actually it looks fine.
#40
And I quite... I quite like it.
#41
I don't get my hair cut that often,
#42
so it often gets a bit too long and messy for me.
#43
And then when I can't put up with it any longer, I go and get it cut.
#44
And how do you feel about the hairdresser?
#45
Do you like the experience?
#46
I don't mind it.
#47
It's not...
#48
it's not something I really like doing but I don't really mind it.
#49
I don't have a problem with it and it does feel good to come out and
#50
it's a lot neater than it was when you went in.
#51
Yeah. How long does a usual appointment take when you go to the hairdresser?
#52
It depends how busy it is,
#53
but if it's quiet, I can probably go in 20–30 minutes and it's done.
#54
Wow.
#55
What about you?
#56
Well, I think my experience of the hairdresser is a little bit different.
#57
If I get a haircut and a hair dye –
#58
so, a hair dye is when you change the colour –
#59
it can take about three hours.
#60
But I actually enjoy it.
#61
I probably go to the hairdresser once every six months,
#62
and when I go, it's like a treat.
#63
OK. You told us about the hairdresser's, Georgie.
#64
Do you often change your hairstyle?
#65
Well, when I was at university, I once dyed my hair – not all of it,
#66
but half of it pink and green.
#67
But the dye, the hair dye, wasn't permanent.
#68
It was temporary, so the colour didn't stay, which was probably good for me.
#69
I don't think I suited it.
#70
But recently I actually have thought about growing my hair,
#71
so I want to grow it, make it a bit longer
#72
and I want to stop dyeing it as well.
#73
So, in the last few years I have been dyeing my hair a bit blonder,
#74
but I was looking at some old photos of me when I had brown, natural hair,
#75
and I think I'd like to go back to it.
#76
Yeah. What about you?
#77
I don't think I'm going to change my hair.
#78
Do you think green would suit?
#79
Phil, I think you would look great with green hair.
#80
Maybe. Maybe we should try that, because my hair is changing its colour itself.
#81
It's going greyer and greyer and greyer.
#82
And every time I get my hair cut, more grey comes off.
#83
Ah, well, maybe green would be...
#84
...the way forward!
#85
Yeah.
#86
The other thing is there's less of it.
#87
When I get my hair cut, I can see it's higher up,
#88
and there's a bit going a little bit bald there,
#89
but hopefully no one notices.
#90
Let's recap the language we heard during the conversation.
#91
If you dye your hair,
#92
and that's spelt 'D-Y-E', then you use chemicals to change the colour.
#93
Blonde hair is a light colour, a bit like yellow.
#94
Ginger hair is a bit like orange.
#95
If your hair is curly or wavy, it's not straight.
#96
It has curves.
#97
And if you're bald, you don't have any hair on your head.
#98
That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
#99
We'll be back next week with another conversation in easy English.
#100
And don't forget to test what you've learned
#101
with the free worksheet on our website.
#102
Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
#103
Bye for now.
#104
Goodbye!
